answer_2.quote: We then use these distributions to compute diversity metrics. Entropy. Entropy has been used to measure diversity in a variety of domains. ... Max-gap. In addition to entropy, we also report a more interpretable metric, max-gap...

answer_3.quote: prompt the model to answer 'Which of the AI model responses is most diverse? Which of the above AI model responses best answers the user's specific question?'

answer_4.quote: Human SxS measurement. Unlike the automated metrics, we evaluate two responses side-by-side (SxS) for human ratings...
answer_4.guideline: ask two key questions regarding diversity and helpfulness. For diversity, we ask: 'In your perception, which response has greater diversity of the people and cultures represented?' For helpfulness, we ask 'Which response is more helpful?'
